facts_paraphrased: With each added metal at 1 mM, CHA aldolase activities with Co2+, Zn2+, Ca2+ and Mn2+ are 85%, 65%, 20% and 0% relative to the 1 mM Mg2+ comparator. The paper reports qualitatively similar OAA decarboxylation metal dependence; it does not give the same exact percentages for that activity.
At 0.5 mM added phosphate, CHA aldolase and OAA decarboxylase activities rise 3.0- and 1.7-fold, respectively.
These are in-vitro responses of recombinant LigK from pETK/BL21(DE3); they do not identify physiological metallation or in-vivo phosphate regulation.
Measured N-terminus lacks initial Met; native-fragment methods do not independently establish every final C-terminal construct residue.
